biggest_catch: Bonus value at the advertised ceiling (estimated ~$3,000 at 1.0¢ per point) minus the $895 annual fee = ~$2,105 first-year net — but the offer is variable/YMMV: you may be shown less than 300,000 points, so only pursue it with spending already planned.
catches: Only pursue this bonus with spending you were already going to make — manufactured or extra spending can erase the gain.

Amex once-per-lifetime rule: the welcome offer is generally not available if you have or have had this exact card before; Amex also considers your history as an Amex Card Member and the number of cards opened/closed.
Applying for this card triggers a hard credit inquiry — do not apply unless you are ready for it.
This card's purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance can wipe out the entire bonus — pay the statement balance in full every month.
The offer is 'as high as' 300,000 points — your actual offer is revealed only when you apply and may be lower; do not count on the ceiling.
The $895 annual fee applies to the first year and is not waived; it hits up front.
You must be a legitimate business to apply — a sole proprietor applying with an SSN qualifies; the account will only be used for business purposes per the issuer's terms.

steps: Open the official American Express Business Platinum card page and confirm the current welcome offer and $895 annual fee.
Confirm you have not had this card before (Amex once-per-lifetime) and that you have a legitimate business (sole proprietor with SSN is fine).
Apply through the official Amex application — it will show your actual welcome-offer amount (possibly less than 300,000 points) before you accept.
If you accept, spend the required threshold (e.g. $20,000) in planned business purchases within the first 3 months of Card Membership.
Pay the balance in full every month — at this fee level, any carried balance destroys the math.
Monitor your Membership Rewards account; allow up to 8–12 weeks after meeting the threshold.
